$comment: ExitIntelligenceEngine.evaluateExit() weights/thresholds. Read-only advisory input to PortfolioMonitor's existing exit checks - never a second execution path. Do not treat these weights as validated/optimal; they are a documented, reviewed starting point, not backtested. Changing this file is a reviewed config change, not a UI knob. Default OFF (ARGUS_EXIT_INTELLIGENCE_ENABLED) - existing PortfolioMonitor behavior (quant stop/target, thesis invalidation, generic trailing/take-profit) is completely unchanged unless explicitly enabled; this only ever adds an additional, lower-priority exit check consulted after every existing one already found nothing.
